Changes to 8tools/pal.c:
  Removed conditionals for PDP8E.  The -e option enables more than just 8/E
features, and is more like "EXTENDED".  No likely reason remains to build a
cross assembler without the "-e" command line option.
  Fixed a compatibility problem by forcing an origin at 0200 at the beginning
of each pass.
  Fixed another compatibility problem by forcing output of all literals for
all FIELD directives, even those that don't change the page or the field.

More changes for 8tools/pal.c:
Added a "missing features" section to the header comment, listing some
  of the known shortcomings.
Added SIXBIT pseudo-op, like TEXT but with n-240 encoding.
Enabled the TITLE pseudo-op, though it doesn't affect the listing yet.
Added more BUGBUG notes describing misfeatures and missing features.
Added DK8-EP IOT instructions.
Added hair to condfalse() to deal with obscure cases involving TEXT,
  SIXBIT, quoted characters, and pointy brackets after /.
Removed remaining calls to nextlexblank, to allow spaces after '(' and '['.
Added an "offpage ind" error if trying to indirectly address offpage.
Fixed a bug where if you ended a pass in LMODE, the next pass failed.
Make the "parens" indicating no closing quote in TEXT/SIXBIT a warning.
Ignore text after "EJECT" directive.
Fixed an quiet but disastrous failure in literal handling.  If you have
  literals for the current page, but completely fill the page, those
  literals were being allocated on the subsequent page!  This also
  caused the "mark12.pa" regression test to begin failing, as it did
  this.
